description: Which wallets are tied to this one? For an address on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon: its first funder, the wallets it funded (their first coin came from it, plus token deployers we recorded), its top counterparties by transfer count and by USD value with exchange and contract labels, and which of them launched tokens we recorded and how many lost their liquidity. From transfer history and our launch records. Not advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.
